item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 22/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting southern China will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Christmas Day. The weather will become cold appreciably over the region afterwards.

Date/Month: 22/12 (Wednesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5.
Weather: Sunny intervals. Cool in the morning.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 23/12 (Thursday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches at night.
Temp range: 19 - 22 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 24/12 (Friday)
Wind: Northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few rain patches.
Temp range: 19 - 21 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low

Date/Month: 25/12 (Saturday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Bright at first. Cool with one or two rain patches at night.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 26/12 (Sunday)

Date/Month: 30/12 (Thursday)

PSR: Low
